subject: LENGTH function
notes: SPLIT=3 is unique to r5: the bare bit sum without the two §8.5.1.6.3 filler runs is 14 bits, which even ceilinged is 2; ADJ=1 is the no-filler control. 2023/l1_length_bit_group_positions measures the same rule on a non-record group but does NOT discriminate it (ceil(11/8)=2 either way), so it is deliberately not recorded here.
